note: Beta 14, the plan (the Windows uninstaller's optional one-tap reason). The sentences of the 'why' card of the uninstall launcher (AciraUninstall.cs) in the 12 languages Acira ships and English. Read by scripts/uninstall-why-art-main.cjs, which renders each language into the art (the launcher embeds pictures, not text). `codes` is the closed list of reasons the usage function accepts (supabase/functions/usage/handler.mjs UNINSTALL_REASONS, desktop/browser-services/usage-facts.cjs UNINSTALL_REASONS): the launcher sends one of these words, never the sentence. `reasons[i]` is the label of `codes[i]`; the card shows them in this order, four to a row, then `skip`. A label has to fit a 120 px button at 10.5 px or more (the art script stops otherwise). The sentences are written for this release and want a native reader before they ship.
